Edwyn Wyndsmithe is an Arathi located in Lightspark in Hallowfall. As a student of the academy, he was aiming to become the next captain and would often talk among his peers about becoming one. Jenae Sacredpyke described him as being a little hard to read, but intelligent, and a great pilot, and thinks he really cares about his classmates. Despite this, he has an ego and thinks anyone else is up to the captain job. According to Headmaster Fynch, Edwyn is extremely confident in his abilities as he's a superb flyer, with a strong mind, and gets along well with others. Elder Cassaphine was a powerful dryad and a friend of Merithra. During the Primalists' attack on the Emerald Dream, Cenarius sent an adventurer to the Barrows of Reverie to rally Cassaphine against Fyrakk's forces. Soon, the enemies attached the Fields of Reverie, and Cassaphine seemingly went to face them. Cenarius briefly saw her as she went to fight, but sent the adventurer to check upon her. Being drawn to a prophecy of flame, The adventurer witnessed the dryad being converted by Ashendir Hartwood and infused with fire to become a flame dryad. The Empowered Restoration Stones are a type of stone similar to meeting stones, found usually half way in a delve. Once a player has reached an Abandoned Restoration Stone, it will be empowered and act as the new spawning point if the player dies, rather than spawning at the start of the delve. Additionally, it provides an additional life for Tier 4+. There is an Explorers' League Supplies found next to it.

The Ethereal Routing Station connects all the delves during The War Within Season 3 and is accessed by using a Flickering Ethereal Portal. These portals have a chance of spawning statically, or can appear after opening a Flickergate. Taking the portal will shortcut to the ending of the delve by having players complete one of five tasks: *Defeat Zekvir and The Underpin (by bringing their health down to 50%) **Zekvir only uses Enfeebling Spittle, Horrendous Roar, and Angler's Web **The Underpin uses most of their abilities at a faster rate (no shield ability); Signal Cronies will be used but will not actually summon them. *Dodge balls and defeat the Steelsoul Arcanoward *Defeat groups of Shado

The Ethereal Voidforged Container is located at atop a broken wall in the Ruins of Yaathron while Phase Diving in K'aresh. Players are required to have the "What Lies Beyond" perk purchased for the Reshii Wraps to see it. To reach the container, complete a jumping puzzle to get up and around the wall and obstacles on the way. Or, cheat and use the Untethered Xy'bucha to enter Untethered Space after flying and landing on the spot. It contains the Buckler of the Last Stand, awards the Jump, Jump, and Away! achievement, and is one of the criteria of Treasures of K'aresh. If the appearance of the cosmetic item is already known, Shattered Buckler of the Last Stand will appear in its place.

Feats of Strength are a type of achievement that represent the player's various glories throughout Azeroth and beyond, and as such, they can be at times very difficult — if not impossible — to earn. They are worth no points, and unlike normal achievements, unearned feats are not displayed in the achievements interface. Feats include obtaining rare mounts, special titles, and more. Some Feats of Strength can still be obtained, while others are no longer possible to get. Deprecated achievements (ones that can't be obtained and have been made obsolete due to changes in the game) can be found in the Legacy tab.

The Festering Core is the prison-vault of G'huun and the final room of Uldir. Accessed by dropping down from a narrow tunnel leading north from the Chamber of Corruption, it consists of a roughly triangular open area in the center, flanked by two raised platforms covered in Amorphous Cysts. Over the course of the encounter, players need to navigate across the platforms to deliver Power Matrices to the Reorigination Drive interfaces in order to activate the Reorigination Drive in the ceiling to kill G'huun's minions, dislodge him from the wall in which he is encased and draw him into the open. An Uldir Teleporter allows transport back to the earlier parts of the raid.

A fey is a creature with supernatural abilities and connections to nature or to some other force or place. Fey are usually human-shaped or have human-shaped portions (such as a humanoid torso and the body of a stag or other wild creature). Faerie dragons are also fey, and this is reflected in the names of certain subtypes such as Fey Dragon and Fey Drake. Note: While fey is used to describe a few specific races with similar characteristics, it does not mean that all are related.

Filo ( ) is a kapara loa worshipped by the forest trolls of Zul'Aman as the Loa of Children. He protects all forest troll children, and the youngest child of every village is his speaker. Filo himself never speaks, but all understand him nonetheless. He is placid and friendly toward those he protects, but will meet those who harm his children with an insatiable and violent rage and is ruthless enough to kill the most powerful warrior if it suits him. Nothing can kill Filo, and even other loa fear his power. If a child dies before their parents, Filo and his attendants will wait with the child's spirit until their parents come to guide them. Filo's name is invoked during troll lullabies.

The Forsaken navy (also known as the Forsaken Fleet) is the maritime military force of the Forsaken.
